title: Retrospective Analysis of Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) Using AI Earth InSAR and Optical Images: A Case Study of South Lhonak Lake, Sikkim
methods_used: Sentinel-1 InSAR time-series (83 asc + 79 desc images), optical imagery
key_finding: Pre-event deformation detected in surrounding moraine
limitation: Short time series (2021-2023 only); no control slopes; no false-alarm analysis; no leave-future-out design
relevance_to_project: Direct overlap with our RQ2 — must compare results and demonstrate our contribution goes beyond

authors: Mohanty L.K., Gantayat P., Dixit A., Das Adhikari M., Biswas R., Singh V.K.
title: Sequence of events that led to the South Lhonak lake outburst flood in Sikkim, India
methods_used: Satellite-derived deformation, event reconstruction, debris/ice volume estimation
key_finding: ~38.31M m³ debris + ~7M m³ ice calving; left lateral moraine failure; event sequence reconstruction
limitation: Volume estimates differ from other studies; single-event reconstruction
relevance_to_project: Physical event understanding; volume estimates for scenario calibration

title: Six decades of lake and glacier evolution at South Lhonak
methods_used: Multi-decadal optical satellite analysis, geomorphological mapping
key_finding: ~12x lake area increase 1962-2023; interacting instability processes

title: Satellite-based assessment of South Lhonak Lake flash flood
methods_used: RISAT-1A and Sentinel-1A comparison, before/after lake area
key_finding: ~105 hectares of lake area drained; before-and-after satellite obs
limitation: Single post-event assessment; no pre-event deformation analysis
relevance_to_project: Official event reference; calibration dates and observations

title: Analyses of the October 2023 South Lhonak GLOF cascade
relevance_to_project: Key reference for alternative volume estimate; hindcast comparison

title: Impulse product parameter in landslide generated impulse waves
journal: J. Waterway, Port, Coastal, and Ocean Engineering
key_finding: Impulse product parameter for predicting wave characteristics from landslide inputs
limitation: Laboratory-scale; scaling to field requires care
relevance_to_project: Core reference for impulse-wave estimation in scenario modelling (Phase E)

authors: Yunjun Z., Fattahi H., Amelung F.
title: Small baseline InSAR time series analysis: unwrapping error correction and noise reduction
key_finding: MintPy software; unwrapping error correction methods
limitation: General tool — not specific to glacial lakes

title: Automatic and precise orthorectification, coregistration, and subpixel correlation of satellite images
key_finding: COSI-Corr software for sub-pixel image correlation

title: r.avaflow v1: advanced open-source computational framework for propagation and interaction of two-phase mass flows
key_finding: r.avaflow software for mass-flow and wave modelling
relevance_to_project: Scenario modelling tool for impulse wave + mass flow (Phase E)

authors: Patlolla S.V.R., Suresh Babu A.V., Sai Bhagheerath Y.V., Sreenivas K.
title: GLOF in the South Lhonak Lake, India: photogrammetric analysis and estimation
journal: Journal of Water and Climate Change
key_finding: Debris entering lake ~11.50 MCM; lake water loss ~43.21 MCM; total flood surge ~54.71 MCM
limitation: Post-event single-image DEM differencing; optical cloud constraints

title: South Lhonak Lake Case Study: Session 5 Sikkim Conclave
methods_used: Field surveys, damage assessment, satellite monitoring framework
key_finding: Lateral moraine destabilization is primary hazard trigger; mandates InSAR monitoring of 189 high-risk Himalayan lakes
limitation: Policy/operational synthesis rather than raw radar processing
relevance_to_project: National policy context and operational early warning justification
